projects.title: School Management System
projects.summary: A complete school administration platform handling students, staff, academics, and finances in one place.

sections.heading: The Challenge
paragraphs: Schools juggle a dozen disconnected tools—attendance books, grade sheets, fee ledgers, and parent communication. Managing this manually is slow, error-prone, and scales poorly as the school grows.

sections.heading: The Solution
paragraphs: I built a unified school management system that brings student records, staff management, class scheduling, attendance tracking, grading, and fee management into a single, easy-to-use dashboard.

sections.heading: Key Features
paragraphs: Student and staff profile management, academic records with grade tracking, fee and payment management, role-based access for admins, teachers, and staff, and responsive design for use on any device.

sections.heading: Impact
paragraphs: The system removes hours of manual administrative work each week, centralizes data in one reliable place, and gives school leaders real-time insight into attendance, grades, and finances.

projects.title: Employee Management System
projects.summary: A system to manage employee records, roles, and departments efficiently.

sections.heading: The Challenge
paragraphs: Managing employee data across spreadsheets and paperwork makes it hard to keep records accurate, searchable, and up to date as teams grow.

sections.heading: The Solution
paragraphs: A web application for managing employee records, including personal details, roles, departments, and employment status, with clean search and filtering.

sections.heading: Key Features
paragraphs: Employee CRUD operations, department and role assignment, search and filter by attribute, and an intuitive interface for everyday HR tasks.

sections.heading: Impact
paragraphs: Replaces manual record-keeping with a fast, searchable system, cutting the time spent finding and updating employee information.

projects.title: Ecommerce
projects.summary: A full-featured online store with product catalogs, cart, and checkout flow.

sections.heading: The Challenge
paragraphs: Building an online store from scratch means wiring together product listings, a shopping cart, orders, and payments into one smooth experience.

sections.heading: The Solution
paragraphs: A complete ecommerce platform with browsable product catalog, category filtering, cart management, and a guided checkout flow.

sections.heading: Key Features
paragraphs: Product catalog with categories and search, add-to-cart and cart persistence, order summaries and checkout, and an admin view for managing products.

sections.heading: Impact
paragraphs: Demonstrates a full purchase journey end-to-end and provides a reusable foundation for real storefront deployments.

projects.title: Property Management System
projects.summary: A platform to manage property listings, tenants, leases, and maintenance requests.

sections.heading: The Challenge
paragraphs: Property owners and managers track listings, tenants, leases, and maintenance issues across many moving parts—often scattered across documents and spreadsheets.

sections.heading: The Solution
paragraphs: A property management system that centralizes property and unit listings, tenant records, lease agreements, and maintenance request tracking.

sections.heading: Key Features
paragraphs: Property and unit management, tenant profiles and lease tracking, maintenance request workflows, and dashboards for quick oversight of each property.

sections.heading: Impact
paragraphs: Gives owners and managers one place to monitor their portfolio, reducing confusion and speeding up everyday operations like move-ins and repairs.
